mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Latest launches: Product Hunt's current featured launches (no token needed). Topics: current launches in one or more topics (no token needed). Leaderboard: daily, weekly or monthly leaderboards for a date range (past dates need an API token). Posts: specific launch URLs (needs an API token).

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Topic slugs or URLs, e.g. artificial-intelligence, developer-tools, productivity or https://www.producthunt.com/topics/saas. Used in Topics mode.

period.title: Leaderboard period
period.description: Leaderboard mode: one leaderboard per day, per week (Monday to Sunday) or per month, in Pacific Time like Product Hunt.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday" or relative like "7 days"). Default: yesterday. With a token this also filters Topics mode.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day, inclusive. Default: same as start date.

postUrls.title: Launch URLs
postUrls.description: Posts mode: Product Hunt launch URLs (https://www.producthunt.com/posts/<slug> or /products/<product>/launches/<slug>), slugs or numeric IDs.

searchKeywords.title: Keywords
searchKeywords.description: Optional. Only keep launches whose name, tagline, description or topics contain any of these comma-separated words (e.g. "crm, sales, outreach"). Filtered-out launches are not charged.

maxItems.title: Max launches
maxItems.description: Stop after this many launches in total. Each launch is billed as one event.

maxPerGroup.title: Max launches per period / topic
maxPerGroup.description: Optional. E.g. 10 = the top 10 of each day in a daily leaderboard range, or 10 per topic.

featuredOnly.title: Featured launches only
featuredOnly.description: With a token: skip launches Product Hunt did not feature on the homepage. Leaderboards are always featured-only, like on the site.

onlyNew.title: Only new launches (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only launches not returned by an earlier run with the same mode, period, topics, posts, keywords and featured filter. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-launch or competitor alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new launches. Dates are not part of the key. State is kept in the key-value store "product-hunt-launches-state" in your account.

apiToken.title: Product Hunt API token (optional)
apiToken.description: Optional free developer token from https://www.producthunt.com/v2/oauth/applications (create an app, then "Create Token"). Unlocks historical leaderboards, specific URLs, descriptions, topics, media, makers and comments. Without it the actor uses Product Hunt's public feed.

includeMakers.title: Include makers
includeMakers.description: With a token: add the makers of each launch. Product Hunt hides personal fields of most users from third-party apps; hidden fields are null.

includeComments.title: Include comments
includeComments.description: With a token: add the most upvoted comments to each launch. Each comment is billed as one (cheaper) comment event.

resolveWebsites.title: Resolve website URLs
resolveWebsites.description: Follow Product Hunt's redirect link to get each product's real website. Best effort: skipped automatically if Product Hunt blocks it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Not needed: the feed and API are not rate-limited per IP for normal volumes.
